claims.text: 蚕丛“其目纵”属于文献传说，不能确证纵目面具就是蚕丛。
青铜神树有三层枝与九鸟；与扶桑、建木的比较属于解释，不能画上等号。
本片祭礼动作、丰收祈愿、人物和建筑布局为艺术想象。

shots.title: 古城黎明
shots.narration: 三千多年前，成都平原上，一座古蜀城迎来黎明。这里是三星堆。它的王是谁？传说留下了名字。
shots.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: full-screen keyframe for a Chinese history documentary film, 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: A richly detailed cinematic reconstruction of the ancient Shu settlement at Sanxingdui, Chengdu plain, approximately late second millennium BCE, dawn seen across the river from a slightly elevated natural bank.
Scene/backdrop: Humid Sichuan plain, broad slow river, modest rammed-earth enclosure, timber and earth dwellings with straw-thatched roofs, scattered agricultural plots and distant wooded hills. A credible Bronze Age settlement rather than an imperial capital. A few tiny people in plain woven clothing on paths; no invented protagonist.
Style/medium: Photorealistic historical film production design, tactile handbuilt architecture, intricate natural textures, real atmospheric perspective, subtle cinematic grain. Carefully composed depth, foreground reeds, midground river and village, layered mist behind.
Lighting/mood: Gentle early morning gold through cool gray-green mist; legible midtones and nuanced shadows.
Materials/textures: Damp soil, irregular plaster, wooden beams, straw, worn woven fabric, water reflections.
Constraints: An artistic reconstruction guided by archaeology, not a literal surveyed site plan. No pagodas, palace megastructures, glazed tiled roofs, Han/Tang architecture, monumental stone temples, alien imagery, fantasy armor or modern objects. No typography, no captions, no borders, no collage, no watermark. Preserve visual interest above the bottom 12 percent reserved for later subtitles.
竖屏重构要求：9:16，主体完整，场景为艺术想象，无字幕或文字。

shots.title: 蚕丛与纵目面具
shots.narration: 古籍说，蜀王蚕丛，其目纵。这张面具，会是他吗？

Asset type: 9:16 full-screen keyframe for a historical documentary, no text.
Style/medium: Photorealistic historical cinema production design, highly detailed textures, atmospheric depth, restrained cinematic grain, believable scale, clear readable midtones. Consistent late Bronze Age Sichuan setting: earthen surfaces, timber and thatch, plain muted woven linen-like clothing, warm fresh bronze and cool gray-green atmosphere. NOT cartoon, NOT vector, NOT glossy game art.
Constraints: Historically cautious artistic reconstruction of Sanxingdui and ancient Shu, late second millennium BCE. No text, no watermark, no collage, no border, no modern objects, no aliens, no European gods, no Han/Tang tiled palaces, no armor fantasy. Do not use the four-bird circular Jinsha gold ornament. Fresh bronze is copper-gold with subtle casting irregularities, not archaeological green patina. Main detail above bottom 12 percent reserved for later subtitles.

Primary request: Cinematic medium close-up of a Sanxingdui-style bronze protruding-eye mask resting vertically in a dark timber-and-earth ritual setting, its face angled slightly so its projecting cylindrical pupils are unmistakable.
Subject: Broad angular bronze face, enormous outward-spreading angular ears, long raised brows, two eyes whose cylindrical eyeballs project substantially from the eye sockets, large straight ridge nose, wide thin mouth with subtly uplifted ends. The silhouette is recognizably the famous Sanxingdui protruding-eye mask, NOT a generic human portrait, Egyptian mask or smooth theatrical mask. Keep ear-to-ear width much larger than face height.
Composition/framing: Artifact fills the portrait frame with both ears fully visible; camera just below eye level, a little to one side, soft shallow depth of field. Do not include a named king or wearer.
Lighting/mood: Raking warm side light revealing hammered/cast metal texture, cool smoky shadow, quiet solemnity. Association with the legendary Cancong is narrative conjecture, not physical identity.
竖屏重构要求：9:16，主体完整，场景为艺术想象，无字幕或文字。
竖屏构图重点：面具置于画面中央，双耳完整，面具宽度占画面约80%，上方留暗色烟雾与木构背景，下方留旁白安全区。禁止文字。

cues.text: 古籍说，蜀王蚕丛，其目纵。
